ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Focused Visit (Care-plan review) — Rachel Carson — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.originalText: Monitoring visit at the start of the fourth ribociclib cycle

text.paragraph: Monitoring visit at the start of the fourth ribociclib cycle. [S]

Ms. Carson is twelve weeks into letrozole and starts her fourth cycle of ribociclib today. The oncology blood tests at about day 14 of the first cycle and on schedule since have shown neutrophils between 1.3 and 1.7, with normal liver tests and electrolytes; the neutrophil count was 1.2 at her sick visit in July, without fever, and she has had no fever since. The ECG planned for about day 14 of the first cycle was not done: she was away on the coast that week for field work and the ECG was not rebooked with her blood test. It was done at the start of the second cycle, four weeks after starting: QTcF 426 ms. She has mild morning knee stiffness for about ten minutes, eased by walking, and occasional night hot flashes. She is finishing the draft of her book this month. [S]
